_usage: Where a record opens in its source system (operating.alert_playbooks.source_links). A record's system is chosen by its binding prefix; its page by its record type. The base URL comes from the environment variable named in base_env and must be https; while it is unset, or a type has no page, the link is not_configured (never guessed). BC pages are the standard web client card pages and the filter is table-qualified, as the BC web client writes it (?company=...&page=...&filter='Table'.'Field' IS 'value'); the base is https://businesscentral.dynamics.com/<tenant>/<environment>?company=<name>; {number} is the record's cited number. Portal and FileMaker record pages are not known yet: add them here when their URL patterns are confirmed. A system with a company block opens each record in its own company: the company is read from the record's cited number (handle_pattern names its environment and company id), named by names_file (names[environment][company id]) and set as the base URL's query_param; a record whose company is not read that way gets no link, never the base's own company.
